Git (reviewed, unchanged): architecture contract, nested contracts, Target model, system landscape (#860)
Greenfield works without source code, without a collector and without a daemon. Rules and Target identity do not depend on the collector.

Rules for all new code: one owner per concept (SPOT) · one reason to change (SOC) · one producer per language and fact kind (DRY) · at most 500 lines per file · port only what a rule or a view uses (YAGNI)
